templates.why_chosen: A three-level stack (Cilantro Scheduler internals, Resource Manager/Kubernetes, and per-job Clients/Job Servers) is connected top-down by red-labelled feedback arrows naming the exact data crossing each level (Res-Perf Data, confidence bounds, allocations).
templates.what_to_learn: Label every cross-tier arrow with the exact data it carries (Res-Perf Data, Load Data, confidence bounds, allocations) in red so the feedback loop reads without extra explanation, and nest each tier's internal modules inside a dashed sub-box; add a legend for the box-fill colours, since this figure leaves that coding unexplained.
